sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24') - count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24') AS value, count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24') - count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24') AS baseline FROM orders.orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
